title:
Every second life
deserves a careful review.
detail:
Laptop recovery, connected to
the software behind it.
label: Live product tour · Synthetic demonstration records
captions: A laptop can be held back by broken software as well as broken hardware.
SpareCycle Review connects what a team observes on the bench to a tested change in its project.

title:
One team.
A shared review bench.
detail:
Projects, devices and change requests
stay with the organization.
label: Actual signed-in workspace · Synthetic integration pilot
captions: The company workspace brings laptop passports, project connections, and change requests together.
Access follows organization membership, so a different company cannot read this team's records.

title:
Start with evidence.
Keep its history.
detail:
Every review refers to a specific
evidence revision.
label: Synthetic parser fixture · No physical hardware diagnosis
captions: This passport contains an observed parser failure, with its source and evidence revision.
The records are synthetic. The failure, model calls, isolated tests, and published draft are real.

title:
Zero is a reading.
Not missing data.
detail:
A valid 0% battery log returns null.
The unchanged test expects zero.
label: Actual completed change · Read back from the live database
captions: Here, a valid zero-percent battery reading is incorrectly discarded as missing data.
The request defines the expected behavior and preserves the existing tests before any code is proposed.

title:
Cloud inference.
NVIDIA reasoning.
detail:
Real inference through
Nebius Token Factory.
No simulated provider results.
label: User-supplied Token Factory view · Account strip excluded
captions: Nebius Token Factory is the cloud inference provider. NVIDIA Nemotron supplies the reasoning models.

title:
Reasoning with
a bounded harness.
detail:
Lightning investigates.
Super proposes and independently reviews.
Nano and Ultra are also verified routes.
label: Actual Nebius response · NVIDIA Nemotron Lightning
captions: In this completed change, Lightning investigated the evidence. Super generated the patch and independently reviewed it with fresh context.

title: Four model tiers. Recorded usage.
detail: Nano and Ultra were separately checked. The completed patch used Lightning and Super.
label: User-supplied usage view · Displayed cost buckets are rounded, not a per-change invoice
captions: The supplied Nebius usage screenshot records Nano, Lightning, Super, and Ultra.
That confirms use across four model tiers, not that every tier wrote this patch. The displayed cost buckets are rounded.

title: Reasoning is bounded. Publication is earned.
detail: The model proposes structured output. Server checks decide what can happen next.
label: Implemented controls · A diagram of the actual Review architecture
captions: Trusted code controls every transition. Structured output, a forty-second model deadline, and reserved spend constrain each stage.
Exact code and evidence hashes, unchanged tests, stale-evidence rejection, and a separate approver protect publication. LangSmith traces contain metadata only.

title:
One proposed fix.
An exact code version.
detail:
The change is tied to a base commit,
a patch hash and an evidence hash.
label: Actual generated patch · Default branch remains unchanged
captions: The proposed patch is restricted to the selected diagnostic parser and checked against the harness rules.
It is bound to an exact repository version and evidence revision. Generating a patch does not make it approved.

chapter: 06 / PROVE THE FAILURE AND THE FIX
title:
A failing baseline.
The same tests pass.
detail:
Before: 1 failed, 3 passed.
After: 4 passed, 0 failed.
The test cases were not changed.
label: Real GitHub Actions execution · Network disabled in test container
captions: An isolated GitHub Actions container first reproduces the failure: one test fails and three pass.
With the candidate, all four unchanged tests pass. Hashes bind this result to the exact code and evidence.

title:
Approval belongs
to this exact fix.
detail:
An independent model review,
then a different organization member.
label: Demonstrated with separate synthetic QA accounts
captions: The independent review receives the original problem and evidence, without the writer's conversation.
A different organization member must approve the tested change. New evidence or code invalidates that approval.

title:
Evidence reaches
the repository.
detail:
Draft PR #1 contains the tested patch
and verification metadata.
It has not been merged.
label: github.com/Golden007-prog/sparecycle/pull/1
captions: The SpareCycle GitHub App created this actual draft pull request with the tested patch and verification metadata.
Technician narratives stay in the workspace. Repository review is still required, and publishing does not mark a laptop repaired.

title: Private repository. Verified end to end.
detail: Nano investigated. Super proposed and reviewed. The test cases stayed unchanged.
label: Execution summary · 11 October 2026 · Private source and repository details excluded
captions: A separate private-repository pilot also completed: encrypted dispatch, one baseline failure, four unchanged tests passing, independent approval, and a real draft pull request. Synthetic QA accounts were used.

title:
Careful fixes.
Better recovery
plans.
detail:
The recovery planner helps teams
allocate declared parts and workshop time.
label: Planning projections use declared inputs · Not measured field outcomes
captions: Review complements the recovery planner, connecting declared parts, workshop time, and repair budgets with a traceable software handoff.

title:
Visible evidence.
Honest boundaries.
detail:
A software fix is not a hardware repair.
Enterprise connections require
provider configuration and verification.
label: Enterprise configuration status is documented with the release
captions: This controlled parser demonstration does not certify physical repairs. Enterprise email, private repository execution, and single sign-on each require separate verified configuration.
